excerpt: CsI[Na] (14.6kg) made the first ever observation of CEvNS in 2017. CENNS-10, a 22kg liquid argon calorimeter, has been operating at the SNS since October 2016. A 10kg array of p-type point contact Ge detectors was scheduled to be deployed later in 2020. An initial 185kg NaI[Tl] array was installed at the SNS in June 2016.
publisher: COHERENT Collaboration / Oak Ridge National Laboratory
title: The COHERENT Detector Suite
